newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian stocks rise on SKB listing report.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian stocks rise on SKB listing report.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 1.79 percent on Thursday as the market's mood was boosted by reports that SKB banka, the country's number two bank, was seeking a listing abroad.
"A listing is approaching but it could take at least three months or even more before it actually happens," Karmen Cerar, a trader at brokerage Poteza said.
The bank declined to make any immediate comment to Reuters, but traders said the listing would probably be on the London Stock Exchange.
* The SBI index rose 21.09 points to 1,200.70.
* Turnover jumped to 793.4 million from 200.6 million.
* Bank SKB rose 6.4 percent to close at 43,630 tolars.
* Warehouse BTC was the biggest gainer, firming 9.67 percent to 13,500 tolars on volume of 977 shares. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
